race.description: Redden Electrical/Wsb Distributors/Sandalwood Poll Merinos Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: FLIRT (7) has returned in fine shape this prep. Beaten just half a length first-up at Murray Bridge then tackled a city Saturday class race last time out and finished third over 1000m. Scored third-up last prep over 1100m at Clare. Small query at this distance but she enjoys a soft run from the good gate and should play a key role. PURFECT LINE (3) came wide and was just fair through the line recently over this trip at Murray Bridge. Draws a better gate this time and is down in grade so watch for a return to form. SANTASTICO (2) has the gate speed to cross from a wide alley. At his best over this journey so must be respected. FOUR ON THE FLOOR (6) ran a cheeky race at Gawler last time and is not out of calculations.
